title: Jerry Seinfeld 2027: Here’s How to Shop Las Vegas Residency Tickets Online
summary: Starting on Feb. 11, 2027, comedian Jerry Seinfeld performs at Encore Theater at Wynn in Las Vegas.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Jerry Seinfeld is set for a new Las Vegas residency in 2027. The residency only has 12 performances at the Encore Theater at Wynn. However, it has a few stops and starts throughout the year starting in February, per Variety .

Tickets to the residency first went on sale through Live Nation and Ticketmaster , while the ticket retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets.

Shop Jerry Seinfeld Las Vegas Residency Tickets at Ticketmaster

However, many of the dates have either sold out or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find Jerry Seinfeld tickets online is through third-party sites, such as StubHub , Vivid Seats , SeatGeek , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All online retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for your show. Prices may be above or below face value at times.

Where to Find Jerry Seinfeld Las Vegas Residency 2027 Tickets Online

EDITOR'S PICK

Find Jerry Seinfeld Tickets at StubHub

find tickets at StubHub

Top choice for concert tickets.

StubHub has all-in pricing, so all fees are listed upfront. The site’s “FanProtect Guarantee” ensures that tickets are valid and delivered in time for the performance. If not, you’ll get your money back. In addition, if the show is canceled and not rescheduled, you’ll receive 120% credit or be offered a full refund without the extra credit.

Tickets are delivered digitally via email, so they’re available on your phone before you go through security. And prices are surprisingly reasonable, even for the hottest tickets. Use our discount code BILLBOARD10 to save an additional $10 at checkout.

Find Jerry Seinfeld Tickets at TicketNetwork

find tickets at TicketNetwork

TicketNetwork has ticket packages, which include parking passes, VIP access, meet and greets and other great experiences. It has tickets to Jerry Seinfeld performances with all-in pricing that lets you see exactly what you’ll pay up front (fees included). You can use our exclusive code BILLBOARD150 to save $150 off purchases over $500, or BILLBOARD300 to save $300 off orders of $1000 and up.

And since TicketNetwork is a resale site, the company says that pricing may sometimes be below face value because tickets aren’t held to a specific price point. It guarantees that the tickets you receive are the ones you purchased and sometimes even better than expected.
